messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: remove individuals with a genotype frequency of the AA genotype above 0.9
parts:
Try this:
# pull out all genotypes as a matrix
g <- pull.geno(mycross) 

# frequency of the "1" genotype for each individual
fAA <- rowMeans(g==1, na.rm=TRUE)
# keep only individuals with fAA <= 0.9

mycross_rev <- subset(mycross, ind=(fAA <= 0.9) )


karl
